Recorded source-scope functional evidence and the exact DEP-J recovery registration blocker.
Added a narrowly verified exception for the Prometheus image-declared /prometheus volume when an exact configured read-only tmpfs masks it in the running mount namespace.
Pinned Memory POST Host to the verified Compose listener while keeping TCP/TLS on loopback; added bounded failure-stage, HTTP-status, and safe response-structure diagnostics.

clone.name: a1-r2b-clone-20260925
clone.root_cause: Clone preparation rotated Companion TS_CORE_MEMORY without rebinding Memory callers.companion.token, which would fail bearer authentication if the request reached it. The old drill also sent loopback Host while fixed Memory allowed only memory.internal:8130, so Host validation would reject first. Actual HTTP status was not persisted. Two source-sync token mappings remained stale and the unknown request deadline was too short. These are acceptance fixture errors, not evidence of lost recovered data.
